_source: Cyberpunk RED Core Rulebook p.193 prints the Reputation ladder and says the GM awards a Level for notable deeds, a new deed replacing the old only when it is higher. Which deed is worth which Level is the GM's call; this table is ours, so the engine can make it from what a job actually left behind.

_rules.deed: A settled job is a deed unless it was clean. Its Level is the base, plus a step for each sign that people saw it, plus a step if it was loud, plus a step for a body count, plus a step for a fee big enough to be talked about, capped at jobCap.
_rules.clean: A job the settlement calls clean earns no Reputation. Getting away without a trace is what takes pressure off; it is also what keeps your name out of the story. That trade is the point.
_rules.reputation: A character's Reputation is the highest deed Level they have earned. It never goes down.
_rules.above: Levels above jobCap are news stories and headlines. The Screamsheet (engine/screamsheet.ts) now prints what the engine recorded, but nothing a player can do is yet a deed above jobCap, so nothing earns them yet.
